Test when node is empty ObjectNode.

5. Node with complex nested structure – ensure walk recurses – maybe output "nested validation passed".

But we need avoid duplication; existing already have customizer adding flag.

We can differentiate by using ExecutionContextCustomizer (different type) – but method overload uses Consumer<ExecutionContext> not ExecutionContextCustomizer. However there is overload with ExecutionContextCustomizer param for other methods, but walk method signature uses Consumer. So we can test with a customizer that modifies context and then throws after modification? Already test exception.
